_about: The Quest Book's story (src/world/quest_book.py; kanto_handoff/QUEST_BOOK_DESIGN.md): per region, arcs of chapters over the Journal's missions. A chapter: mission (its id), title, say (its page), optional steps (part of a mission: those way-points), done / when (the chapter's own conditions).

chapters.title: The First Step
chapters.say: The tall grass north of Pallet Town is calling. Something tells you today won't be an ordinary day...

chapters.title: Three Poke Balls
chapters.say: Three Poke Balls sit on Professor Oak's table. One of them holds the partner who'll go everywhere with you.

chapters.title: An Errand Up North
chapters.say: The road north leads to Viridian City. The shopkeeper there has been waiting for someone from Pallet Town.

chapters.title: The Professor's Gift
chapters.say: The parcel is light, but Professor Oak will want it in his hands. He looked like he had plans for you.

chapters.title: The Locked Gym
chapters.say: Viridian's Gym has stood empty for a long time. So why are there footsteps inside?

chapters.title: Into the Forest
chapters.say: Past Route 2 the trees close in. Bug Catchers know every path of Viridian Forest... and every trap.

chapters.title: Hard as Rock
chapters.say: Pewter City is a city of stone, and its Gym Leader is the hardest stone of all.

chapters.title: East to the Mountain
chapters.say: Route 3 winds east toward a mountain where, they say, stones fell from the stars.

chapters.title: Shadows in Mt. Moon
chapters.say: Men in black uniforms are digging deep in the cave. Whatever they're after, they don't want to be seen.

chapters.title: Light at the End
chapters.say: The tunnels go on and on. Somewhere ahead, the air smells of water.

chapters.title: The Man in the Cottage
chapters.say: North of Cerulean a bridge full of trainers, and past it a seaside cottage. The scientist who lives there hasn't been himself lately.

chapters.title: The Tomboyish Mermaid
chapters.say: Cerulean's Gym Leader rules the water. Her pool has swallowed many challengers.

chapters.title: South to the Sea
chapters.say: Below Saffron's locked gates runs a tunnel to the coast, and to Kanto's busiest port.

chapters.title: A Ship at the Harbour
chapters.say: A luxury liner is in port, and your ticket says you're invited. Its Captain hasn't left his cabin in days.

chapters.title: The Lightning American
chapters.say: Vermilion's Gym crackles behind a little tree. Its Leader once won a war with Electric Pokemon.

chapters.title: The Dark Tunnel
chapters.say: East of Cerulean lies a tunnel with no light at all. On the other side, a quiet town.

chapters.title: Whispers in Lavender
chapters.say: Lavender Town is quiet, too quiet. People say a ghost walks the Pokemon Tower, and that no one can see what it really is.

chapters.title: The Poster on the Wall
chapters.say: Celadon's Game Corner is loud and bright. But the man by the poster at the back isn't playing...

chapters.title: Under the Game Corner
chapters.say: Arrows on the floor, an elevator with no key, and somewhere below, the boss of Team Rocket.

chapters.title: Nature's Gym
chapters.say: Celadon's Gym is a garden, and its Leader is said to be gentle. Her Pokemon are not.

chapters.title: The Ghost of the Tower
chapters.say: With the Silph Scope, the Tower's ghost can't hide any more. And at the very top, someone needs help.

chapters.title: The Sleeping Giant
chapters.say: Something enormous is asleep across the road south of Lavender. Nothing seems to wake it... nearly nothing.

chapters.title: The Ninja's Gym
chapters.say: Fuchsia's Gym is a maze of walls you can't see. Its Leader is a master of poison.

chapters.title: The House in the Safari
chapters.say: At the far end of the Safari Zone stands a little house. They say whoever reaches it is given a gift for the sea.

chapters.title: The Warden's Smile
chapters.say: The Safari Zone's Warden is mumbling something nobody can understand. Something of his is missing out in the Zone.

chapters.title: Thirsty Guards
chapters.say: Saffron's gates are guarded day and night, and the guards look parched. Someone in Celadon makes a very good cup of tea.

chapters.title: Silph Co. Taken
chapters.say: Team Rocket has seized the tallest building in Kanto. Doors are locked on every floor, but keys have a way of being dropped.

chapters.title: The Boardroom
chapters.say: A warp pad, an old rival, and at the top of the tower the man behind everything.

chapters.title: The President's Thanks
chapters.say: Silph Co. is free. Its President is waiting upstairs, and he's not a man who forgets a favour.

chapters.title: The Master of Psychic
chapters.say: With the Rockets gone, Saffron's real Gym opens its doors. Its Leader is said to read minds.

chapters.title: Across the Water
chapters.say: An island with a volcano lies south of Kanto. Only a Pokemon that can Surf will get you there.

chapters.title: The Burned Mansion
chapters.say: The Gym door won't open. On the north of the island, a burned mansion keeps a diary nobody was meant to read.

chapters.title: The Hotheaded Quiz Master
chapters.say: Cinnabar's Gym is full of questions, and its Leader is full of fire.

chapters.title: The Leader Returns
chapters.say: The lights are on in Viridian's Gym at last. Its Leader has come home, and he's been waiting for you.

chapters.title: Victory Road
chapters.say: West of Viridian a road climbs through the rock. Only trainers with all eight badges are allowed to try it.

chapters.title: The Elite Four
chapters.say: Four of the strongest trainers in Kanto stand between you and the title. And behind them, someone you know.

chapters.title: The Professor's Errand
chapters.say: Prof. Elm has a friend on Route 30 who says he's found something amazing. Elm won't say what it is. Maybe he doesn't know.

chapters.title: Mr. Pokemon's Discovery
chapters.say: A little house at the end of Route 30. The old man inside guards his find like treasure... and today he has a famous visitor.

chapters.title: A Stranger in Cherrygrove
chapters.say: On the road home, a red-haired boy steps out in front of you. He looks like he's been waiting.

chapters.title: Trouble at the Lab
chapters.say: There's a policeman at Prof. Elm's Lab, and the Professor looks pale. Something has gone missing.

chapters.title: The Swaying Tower
chapters.say: Sprout Tower sways but never falls. The Sages at the top test every trainer who climbs it... and someone has already climbed it today.

chapters.title: Wings Over Violet
chapters.say: Violet's Gym stands high above the city. Its Leader says no one has ever clipped his Pokemon's wings.

chapters.title: Under the Ground
chapters.say: South of Violet, the road dives into Union Cave. Somewhere past the dark, a sleepy town is waiting.

chapters.title: The Well of Tails
chapters.say: Azalea's Slowpoke have gone missing, and men in black stand guard at the old well. An old ball-maker named Kurt is furious.

chapters.title: The Bug Master
chapters.say: With the well quiet again, Azalea's Gym opens its doors. Its young Leader knows everything about Bug Pokemon... and they swarm.

chapters.title: The Runaway Bird
chapters.say: In Ilex Forest it's dark even at noon. A charcoal maker's apprentice has lost his Farfetch'd somewhere among the trees.

chapters.title: The Big City
chapters.say: North of the forest lies Goldenrod, the biggest city in Johto. You can hear it long before you see it.

chapters.title: Rumours on Route 36
chapters.say: Everyone in Goldenrod is talking about a tree on Route 36 that wiggles. Trees don't wiggle. Do they?

chapters.title: The Unstoppable Miltank
chapters.say: Goldenrod's Gym Leader smiles a lot. Trainers who've faced her Miltank don't.

chapters.title: The Tree That Wiggled
chapters.say: That tree on Route 36 is still in the way. The girl at Goldenrod's flower shop might know what a thirsty tree needs.

chapters.title: Ashes of the Burned Tower
chapters.say: Ecruteak's Burned Tower fell to a fire long ago. Someone you know is already inside, poking through the ashes.

chapters.title: Three Beasts Awaken
chapters.say: Deep in the basement, three shapes lie still under the ash. The old stories say they are waiting for someone.

chapters.title: The Mystic Seer
chapters.say: Ecruteak's Gym Leader sees things no one else can. Watch your step: his Gym hides more than it shows.

chapters.title: The Dancers' Trouble
chapters.say: Olivine's lighthouse has gone dark, and its keeper won't leave her sick Ampharos. Meanwhile, back in Ecruteak, a stranger in black is bothering the Kimono Girls.

chapters.title: Across the Whirling Sea
chapters.say: Cianwood City lies across the open sea, west of Olivine. Its pharmacy makes a medicine no one else can.

chapters.title: The Secret Potion
chapters.say: The pharmacist knows exactly what Amphy needs. He's just been waiting for someone to ask.

chapters.title: The Waterfall Fighter
chapters.say: Cianwood's Gym Leader trains under a waterfall, all day, every day. His Pokemon hit like falling rocks.

chapters.title: A Light for the Sea
chapters.say: Amphy is waiting at the top of the lighthouse, and the ships out at sea are waiting for its light.

chapters.title: The Steel-Clad Defense
chapters.say: With the lighthouse shining again, Olivine's Gym Leader is back at her post. Her Steel Pokemon don't dent easily.

chapters.title: The Red Gyarados
chapters.say: Strange news from the Lake of Rage, north of Mahogany Town: a lake that won't calm down, and a Gyarados as red as fire.

chapters.title: The Shop with No Customers
chapters.say: A trainer in a cape has been watching the lake too. He says Mahogany's little souvenir shop is hiding something big.

chapters.title: Ice on the Floor
chapters.say: Mahogany's Gym is a floor of ice. Its Leader is old, patient, and very, very cold.

chapters.title: The Tower Taken
chapters.say: Goldenrod's radio is playing a voice it shouldn't. Team Rocket has taken the Radio Tower, and they're calling out for their missing boss.

chapters.title: Under Goldenrod
chapters.say: The key opens a door deep beneath the city's streets. Someone down there has been locked away for days.

chapters.title: The Top of the Tower
chapters.say: The card opens the upper floors. At the very top, the last of Team Rocket's leaders is waiting.

chapters.title: The Ice Path
chapters.say: East of Mahogany, a frozen cave climbs into the mountains. The floor is ice, and the ice doesn't let you stop.

chapters.title: The Dragon Tamer
chapters.say: Blackthorn's Gym Leader is proud, sharp and cousin to a very famous trainer. Her dragons don't like to lose.

chapters.title: The Elder's Questions
chapters.say: She won't hand the badge over. Instead she points to a shrine in a cave full of dragons, where an old man waits with questions.

chapters.title: Three Wise Sages
chapters.say: Bellchime Trail rings with bells nobody is ringing. Three sages guard the way, and they don't step aside for just anyone.

chapters.title: A Wing of Many Colours
chapters.say: Inside the Bell Tower, an old Sage is holding something for you. It shimmers in every colour at once.

chapters.title: Victory Road
chapters.say: East of New Bark, the road to the League crosses the sea and climbs through the rock. Only trainers with all eight badges get through.

chapters.title: The Elite Four
chapters.say: Four of the strongest trainers in Johto stand between you and the title. Behind them waits a man in a cape.

chapters.title: The Trainer in the Snow
chapters.say: High on Mt. Silver, where the snow never stops, someone has been training alone for years. They say he never says a word.
